scope: Pure retained-response preparation into the existing work-order mapping desk. No target tenant read/write, new posting, historical import or completeness certification.

requires: companyContext: exact original generalLedgerSetup single-record URL/body/id

collections.workOrderIdentity: Not established by documented response; stays missing. planNo cannot substitute.

originalFields: Every original top-level field is carried in native:<field> plus native-type:<field>. Literal strings, booleans and original numeric tokens remain directly mappable; complete nested arrays/objects remain JSON. The type column distinguishes absence, null, empty text and numeric values. Exact page text remains authoritative.
numericPolicy: No JS Number for amounts, quantities or sequence IDs. Selected decimals expand exponent notation exactly, then use the original engine's 80 whole/18 fractional digit contract. Native numeric spellings remain in raw pages and native columns. Unsupported precision rejects preparation instead of rounding.

statuses.NEEDS_SOURCE_OR_REVIEW: One or more required original fields are unavailable. Existing work-order mapping/reconciliation remains authoritative.
statuses.PREPARED_SOURCE_REQUIRES_EXISTING_WORKSP: Prepared source only; neither destination matching nor tenant acceptance established.
